## SEO Agent – Error Handler
Runs whenever any SEO Agent workflow fails (after retries). Creates a HIGH alert in the SEO Agent (visible on the dashboard) which is dispatched to the configured Email / Slack / Teams / Telegram channels. n8n failures never disappear silently.

Requires n8n env vars: SEO_API_URL, SEO_API_KEY (service key), SEO_PROJECT_ID. All logic runs in the SEO Agent API; every call is retried 3× and failures trigger the Error Handler workflow.
